name: zana-command-center-website

scripts.db:migrate: node -e "const p='./lib/db/migrate.mjs'; import(p).catch(e=>{ if(e.code==='ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND'){console.log('db:migrate: lib/db/migrate.mjs not present yet (Phase 1) — skipping.'); process.exit(0);} throw e; })"
